purpose: Allow Meme Alpha Lab to learn from multiple traded and observational chains while preventing silent transfer of chain-specific thresholds, hindsight leakage or execution authority.
principle: Research breadth may exceed execution breadth when additional ecosystems provide high expected information gain for reusable alpha features.

chain_roles.LIVE_CANDIDATE_UNIVERSE: A separately governed chain/venue may produce live candidates only when its own adapter, origin semantics, execution-pool semantics, sellability checks and prospective gate are validated.
chain_roles.SHADOW_LEARNING: Collect point-in-time evidence and outcomes, but no user alert or live-rule authority unless separately promoted.
chain_roles.OBSERVATIONAL_LAB: Research-only ecosystem used to discover or falsify transferable hypotheses; no execution intent is implied.
chain_roles.UNSUPPORTED: No structured inference beyond archived raw evidence.

research_priority.objective: Maximize expected information gain and prospective edge, not equal chain coverage.
high_value_conditions: new launch mechanics expose earlier or cleaner token-origin evidence
wallet funding ancestry or bundle structure is observable
liquidity migration or graduation creates measurable state transitions
successful-sell evidence can falsify honeypot or exit-feasibility claims
early-wallet recurrence can be frozen before outcome
positive and matched negative cases can both be retained
social propagation timing can be separated from on-chain discovery
downsample_conditions: provider data cannot preserve exact token identity
cost or rate limits exceed expected research value
